rows.acip: ,DE JI LTA BA BZHIN DU KHAMS RNAMS KYANG RANG RANG GI CHA SHAS 'DUS PA LA BRTEN NAS BTAGS PA YIN PA'I PHYIR YANG DAG PAR MA GRUB ZHES BSTAN TO, , DE BZHIN DU PHUNG SOGS KYI CHOS THAMS CAD KYANG RANG RANG GI CHA SHAS DANG TSOGS PA LA BRTEN NAS BTAGS PA YIN PA'I PHYIR RANG DBANG DU GRUB PA MED CES SBYOR RO, , RANG GI GZUGS PHUNG NI YAN LAG LNGA SOGS LA BRTEN NAS BTAGS PA DANG , YAN LAG RNAMS KYANG CHA CAN PHUNG PO DANG RANG GI PHYOGS KYI CHA LA BRTEN NAS BTAGS PA DANG , NYING LAG SOR MO LTA BU YANG RANG GI CHA CAN DANG CHA SHAS LA BRTEN NAS BTAGS PA DANG ,
rows.wylie: de ji lta ba bzhin du khams rnams kyang rang rang gi cha shas 'dus pa la brten nas btags pa yin pa'i phyir yang dag par ma grub zhes bstan to, , de bzhin du phung sogs kyi chos thams cad kyang rang rang gi cha shas dang tshogs pa la brten nas btags pa yin pa'i phyir rang dbang du grub pa med ces sbyor ro, , rang gi gzugs phung ni yan lag lnga sogs la brten nas btags pa dang , yan lag rnams kyang cha can phung po dang rang gi phyogs kyi cha la brten nas btags pa dang , nying lag sor mo lta bu yang rang gi cha can dang cha shas la brten nas btags pa dang
rows.english: Just so none of these elements themselves exist purely, for they too are simply labelled upon the parts that they include. This same reasoning can be applied to the heaps of parts that make up a person, and all other objects as well: you can say about all of them that, because they are labelled on their parts and their whole, they do not exist independently. The physical heap of parts that I myself possess is something labelled upon my five appendages and so on; these appendages themselves are something labelled upon the body as a whole and the parts that go off to each side of it; and the smaller appendages like fingers and toes too are labelled upon their whole and their parts.

rows.acip: [C72] 'JIG RTEN SOGS KYIS YAN LAG LNGA LDAN GYI TSANGS DBYANGS TE,
rows.wylie: [c72] 'jig rten sogs kyis yan lag lnga ldan gyi tshangs dbyangs te
rows.english: (S25) As expressed in the words “through the world and the rest” [that is, through his oath that he should one day be able to speak the Dharma in such a way that a single utterance could be understood by every living being, in accordance with their level of virtue], our Teacher attained a “voice as sweet as a god's,” which has five wonderful qualities.

rows.acip: DE BZHIN DU GZUGS PHUNG YANG MGO LA SOGS PA'I YAN LAG LNGA TSOGS PA'I STENG NAS BZHAG PA YIN GYI, YAN LAG LNGA RE RE NAS GZUGS PHUNG DE MA YIN ZHING YAN LAG LNGA LAS NGO BO THA DAD PA'I GZUGS PHUNG SPYI TZAM PA DE MED DO,,
rows.wylie: de bzhin du gzugs phung yang mgo la sogs pa'i yan lag lnga tshogs pa'i steng nas bzhag pa yin gyi, yan lag lnga re re nas gzugs phung de ma yin zhing yan lag lnga las ngo bo tha dad pa'i gzugs phung spyi tsam pa de med do
rows.english: Even just the physical part of us—our body—is also just something that we establish on the basis of the combination of the head and other four components that make it up. It's not as though each of these components alone were the entire body; nor is there some overall body which is somehow different from these parts, and unrelated to them.

rows.acip: DANG PO LA BEM SHES LDAN MIN 'DU BYED GSUM LAS, DANG PO LUS LTA BU LA MTSON NA DE YANG SHA RUS RDOS BCAS KYI YAN LAG LNGA TSOGS TZAM GYI LUS 'DI'I STENG DU, RTOG PAS BTAGS PA TZAM MA YIN PAR TSUGS THUB TU GRUB PA'I LUS YO RE BA ZHIG YOD PAR RANG CAG RNAMS LA BSNYON MED DU 'CHAR BA NI DGAG BYA'I SNANG TSUL YIN LA,
rows.wylie: dang po la bem shes ldan min 'du byed gsum las, dang po lus lta bu la mtshon na de yang sha rus rdos bcas kyi yan lag lnga tshogs tsam gyi lus 'di'i steng du, rtog pas btags pa tsam ma yin par tshugs thub tu grub pa'i lus yo re ba zhig yod par rang cag rnams la bsnyon med du 'char ba ni dgag bya'i snang tshul yin la
rows.english: For the first of these, we cover three different types of caused things: material things, mental things, and then changing things which are neither material nor mental.  To represent material things, we can take something like our own body. In actuality this body is nothing more than a collection of the five components [four limbs and a head]--nothing but flesh and bone in a certain configuration.  In actuality it's nothing more than a projection; but to us it appears as though it were, indisputably, some whole, discrete, and self-standing body. This is how the thing we deny appears to us.

rows.acip: DE LTA BU'I LUS DE SHA RUS RDOS BCAS KYI YAN LAG LNGA TSOGS TZAM GYI LUS 'DI'I STENG DU YOD NA, SHA RUS RDOS BCAS KYI YAN LAG LNGA TSOGS TZAM GYI LUS 'DI DANG GCIG TU GRUB BAM THA DAD DU GRUB,
rows.wylie: de lta bu'i lus de sha rus rdos bcas kyi yan lag lnga tshogs tsam gyi lus 'di'i steng du yod na, sha rus rdos bcas kyi yan lag lnga tshogs tsam gyi lus 'di dang gcig tu grub bam tha dad du grub
rows.english: Now suppose there really were a body like that within this other body, the one which is nothing more than a collection of the five components--nothing but flesh and bone in a certain configuration.  The question then would be whether it was one with, or distinct from, the body of the mere collection of components, the flesh-and-blood configuration.

The question then would be whether it was one with, or distinct from, the body of the mere collection of components, the flesh-and-blood configuration."}

rows.acip: GCIG TU GRUB NA SHA RUS RDOS BCAS KYI YAN LAG LNGA TSOGS TZAM GYI LUS 'DI PHA MA'I KHU KHRAG LAS GRUB PA YIN PAS,
rows.wylie: gcig tu grub na sha rus rdos bcas kyi yan lag lnga tshogs tsam gyi lus 'di pha ma'i khu khrag las grub pa yin pas
rows.english: Let's say it was one with it.  The fact is that the body which is nothing more than the five components pasted together--the flesh-and-blood lump--is something that's made from the semen and blood of your parents.
rows.raw: {"course": "TCS03", "acip": "GCIG TU GRUB NA SHA RUS RDOS BCAS KYI YAN LAG LNGA TSOGS TZAM GYI LUS 'DI PHA MA'I KHU KHRAG LAS GRUB PA YIN PAS,", "wylie": "gcig tu grub na sha rus rdos bcas kyi yan lag lnga tshogs tsam gyi lus 'di pha ma'i khu khrag las grub pa yin pas", "english": "Let's say it was one with it.  The fact is that the body which is nothing more than the five components pasted together--the flesh-and-blood lump--is something that's made from the semen and blood of your parents."}

rows.acip: RNAM SHES 'JUG PA'I GZHIR GYUR PA'I KHU KHRAG GI THIGS PA DE YANG SHA RUS RDOS BCAS KYI YAN LAG LNGA TSOGS TZAM GYI LUS SU 'GYUR BA DANG ,
rows.wylie: rnam shes 'jug pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i khu khrag gi thigs pa de yang sha rus rdos bcas kyi yan lag lnga tshogs tsam gyi lus su 'gyur ba dang
rows.english: This means then that the first little ball of semen and blood which acts as the place where consciousness first enters would then have to be a body that was nothing more than the combination of the five components, the flesh-and-blood configuration.
rows.raw: {"course": "TCS03", "acip": "RNAM SHES 'JUG PA'I GZHIR GYUR PA'I KHU KHRAG GI THIGS PA DE YANG SHA RUS RDOS BCAS KYI YAN LAG LNGA TSOGS TZAM GYI LUS SU 'GYUR BA DANG ,", "wylie": "rnam shes 'jug pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i khu khrag gi thigs pa de yang sha rus rdos bcas kyi yan lag lnga tshogs tsam gyi lus su 'gyur ba dang", "english": "This means then that the first little ball of semen and blood which acts as the place where consciousness first enters would then have to be a body that was nothing more than the combination of the five components, the flesh-and-blood configuration."}

rows.english: And since there were five components, the body too would have to be five bodies, all of them collections of five components.

rows.acip: BZHI PA LNGA PA GNYIS NI YAN LAG GI RNAM PAR GSAL BA LTA BU RA MA GNYIS DANG , DRUG PA LA YAN LAG LNGA GRUB PA NAG PA LTA BU, BDUN PAR MGO RDZOGS PAR GRUB CING YAN LAG GZHAN RDZOGS PAR MA GRUB PA SENG+GE LTA BU, BRGYAD PAR YAN LAG THUNG NGU GRUB PA MI'U THUNG LTA BU,
rows.wylie: bzhi pa lnga pa gnyis ni yan lag gi rnam par gsal ba lta bu ra ma gnyis dang , drug pa la yan lag lnga grub pa nag pa lta bu, bdun par mgo rdzogs par grub cing yan lag gzhan rdzogs par ma grub pa seng+ge lta bu, brgyad par yan lag thung ngu grub pa mi'u thung lta bu
rows.english: In the fourth and fifth months, the limbs are completely distinct, like the two different Ramas.  In the sixth month, all four limbs and the head are formed in a way that recalls the Black One, Krishna.  In the seventh, the head is completely formed, but the four limbs are not quite finished; and so the fetus looks like lion.  In the eighth month, the four limbs extend out like miniatures, so that the fetus resembles a dwarf.

rows.acip: DE DANG (BCAS) PA STE MNYAM DU SANGS RGYAS KYI ZHING GRANGS MED PA'I (RDUL) PHRA RAB KYI GRANGS DANG (MNYAM PA'I LUS SPRUL) NAS YAN LAG LNGA SA LA GTZUGS PA'I (PHYAG 'TSAL) BA NI LUS KYI PHYAG YIN LA, DE DAG LAS RE RE TZAM MA YIN PAR THAMS CAD KYIS 'DUD PA'I PHYIR RO,,
rows.wylie: de dang (bcas) pa ste mnyam du sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i (rdul) phra rab kyi grangs dang (mnyam pa'i lus sprul) nas yan lag lnga sa la gtsugs pa'i (phyag 'tshal) ba ni lus kyi phyag yin la, de dag las re re tsam ma yin par thams cad kyis 'dud pa'i phyir ro
rows.english: As we are doing so--at the same time--we send forth copies of our body, equal in number to the tiny atoms that make up countless numbers of Buddha paradises.  And then we bow ourselves down, touching the five points of our body to the ground--which is to bow down in our actions.  And it's not as though we bow only with any one of these bodies; we throw ourselves down with every one of them.

And then we bow ourselves down, touching the five points of our body to the ground--which is to bow down in our actions.  And it's not as though we bow only with any one of these bodies; we throw ourselves down with every one of them."}
